title: Implement automated deployment pipeline for staging environment
body: The current manual deployment process to staging takes 45 minutes and is error-prone. We need an automated pipeline that handles build, test, and deploy steps with proper rollback capability. This would reduce deployment time to under 5 minutes and eliminate human error in the process.

overlord_assessment.rationale: High-impact infrastructure improvement that directly reduces deployment friction and human error. Aligns with Q4 reliability goals.
